newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican peso extends slide, spot at 7.685 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Mexican peso extends slide, spot at 7.685 per dlr.

text.p: Mexico's peso steepened its slide against the dollar before Friday's close, falling more than seven centavos in 24-hour trade and 6.6 centavos in the 48-hour spot contract.
The 24-hour peso was off 7.4 centavos at 7.675/7.68, while the 48-hour dropped to 7.68/7.685.

Dealers said foreign investors and local banks were moving out of the Mexican market as a precautionary measure ahead of Wednesday's consumer price index data. U.S. markets are closed on Monday, which added to the caution.
